mechanism: Bumetanide-induced electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium and magnesium) may increase risk of QT prolongation and cardiac arrhythmias, compounded by valbenazine's known dose-dependent QT interval prolongation.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, maintain normal potassium and magnesium levels, obtain baseline and periodic ECGs, and consider alternative diuretic if QT prolongation develops.
